feeds.title: Switzerite Blog
feeds.description: Switzerite Blog is loaded with Waldorf curriculum conversations, integration, and places of intersection of Waldorf ideas with traditional approaches, homeschooling, Montessori and Reggio methods, and academia.

feeds.title: Seasons of Seven Blog
feeds.description: Melanie Lives in the beautiful seaside town of Neptune Beach, Florida. She is a trained teacher by trade but has chosen to homeschool her son with the healing powers of Waldorf Inspired education. She is amazed by the deep, rich, satisfying bond it creates with her child. Melanie has a University degree in Education and has been Coaching & mentoring homeschooling families for several years. Her dream is to bring Waldorf Inspired education into the hearts and homes of families around the world. Seasons of Seven and Waldorf Essentials have been able to help make this dream a reality!

feeds.title: Hearth & Gnome Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Hearth & Gnome! I am Kimberly Parsons, a musician, educator, and homeschooling mother of two. I started Hearth & Gnome to share not only Music Unfolds with families interested in the Waldorf pedagogy, but to share additional work that is not purely Waldorf, but Waldorf-inspired. I love blending the most beautiful elements of Waldorf with mainstream education and sharing them in my own teaching practice, but here as well.

feeds.title: This Lovely Day Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Abby. I am a mother of four. I love creating things, cooking, and spending time outside. When I first began my homeschooling journey I was overwhelmed by the abundance of materials and resources out there. Our curriculum is designed to inspire and guide you as a parent and educator to create a gentle holistic learning experience with plenty of time for family, nature exploration, and wonder. Make every day of learnings a beautiful adventure!

feeds.title: Simply Waldorf Blog
feeds.description: Our article and videos highlight a variety of tips and guidelines for implementing a Waldorf Curriculum whether for homeschool, charter, or private school including what is a main lesson and main lesson block, balancing form and freedom, the importance of story in Waldorf, and the four temperaments.

feeds.title: Waldorfy Blog
feeds.description: We exist to bring Waldorf ideas and methods to all. At the heart of our ethos is creating joy in the parenting process, our means is a Waldorf philosophy. We hope to inspire a movement to preserve the magic of childhood. Waldorfy's primary aim is to serve as a resource for interested parents.

feeds.title: Seasons of Joy Blog
feeds.description: Sandra Huffman specializes in helping clients with outrageous goals and book-writing dreams. She launched her coaching practice after a successful career in sales/marketing and project management. Through her coaching, Sandra provides clients with clarity - not only of their goals but also their blocks - and works with them to consistently move forward in the direction of their goals.
